scenes.title: What is Chemical Bonding?
scenes.explanation: Chemical bonding is the attractive and repulsive forces between atoms that hold them together in a molecule.
scenes.narration: Chemical bonding is the attractive and repulsive forces between atoms that hold them together in a molecule.
scenes.visual_prompt: A simple 2D illustration of two atoms with electrons orbiting around them, connected by a spring

scenes.title: Types of Chemical Bonds
scenes.explanation: There are three main types of chemical bonds: ionic, covalent, and metallic bonds.
scenes.narration: There are three main types of chemical bonds: ionic, covalent, and metallic bonds.
scenes.visual_prompt: An illustration of an ionic bond, a covalent bond, and a metallic bond, with simple diagrams and labels

scenes.title: Electron Sharing and Attraction
scenes.explanation: Chemical bonds are formed when atoms share or exchange electrons to achieve a stable electronic configuration.
scenes.narration: Chemical bonds are formed when atoms share or exchange electrons to achieve a stable electronic configuration.
scenes.visual_prompt: An illustration of electron sharing between two atoms, with arrows showing electron flow

scenes.title: Polar and Nonpolar Covalent Bonds
scenes.explanation: Polar covalent bonds have a partial positive charge on one atom and a partial negative charge on another.
scenes.narration: Polar covalent bonds have a partial positive charge on one atom and a partial negative charge on another.
scenes.visual_prompt: An illustration of a polar covalent bond with an arrow showing the direction of electron flow

scenes.title: Chemical Bonding in Practice
scenes.explanation: Understanding chemical bonding helps us explain the properties and behavior of molecules in everyday life.
scenes.narration: Understanding chemical bonding helps us explain the properties and behavior of molecules in everyday life.
scenes.visual_prompt: An illustration of a molecule with bonds labeled, surrounded by simple diagrams of everyday objects that use those molecules

scenes.title: Conclusion
scenes.explanation: Chemical bonding is a fundamental concept in chemistry that helps us understand the behavior of atoms and molecules.
scenes.narration: Chemical bonding is a fundamental concept in chemistry that helps us understand the behavior of atoms and molecules.
scenes.visual_prompt: A simple 2D illustration of a molecule with the words "Chemical Bonding" written above it
